description: Declared mutants of v8-tool-voxel-map-editor-core (judgment E9 of the declaration in docs/tools/plans/v8/voxel-map-editor.md) and of v8-arch-big-map-tool-chunked (judgment T7, the tc-* entries; docs/tools/plans/v8/voxel-map-tool-chunked.md), run with docs/architecture/plans/time-threads-trace/scripts/run_mutations.py --catalog docs/tools/plans/v8/scripts/voxel_map_editor_mutations.json --build-dir build/target/_build/test. A mutant is killed only when its check fails with the expected message. Test-case filters must not contain commas.

mutants.what: A face is dropped beside any block, covered or not
The neighbour's far side decides, not the side touching the face
The orientation table is off by one quarter turn
Boxes turn about the cell corner instead of its centre

mutants.what: Runs that do not cover 4096 cells are accepted
mutants.find: if (filled != ChunkCells) Fail("the runs of a chunk cover exactly 4096 cells", path + ".runs");

mutants.what: An empty cell with an orientation is accepted
mutants.find: if (block == 0 && orientation != 0) Fail("an empty cell has orientation 0", At(runPath, 1));

mutants.what: The writer splits equal cells into separate runs

mutants.replace: for (const auto& [r, start] : open) static_cast<void>(r), static_cast<void>(start);

mutants.what: Up and down faces swap their brightness

mutants.replace: for (const auto& r : rectangles) chunk.quads.push_back(QuadOf(dir, plane, r, palette));

mutants.what: A rectangle grows along v when only the first square of the next row is free
